stories.headline: Phonic launches Phonic-1 and Series A
stories.summary: Phonic introduced Phonic-1, its speech-to-speech model for agentic tasks, and disclosed a $27.5M Series A.
stories.why_it_matters: Voice-first AI agents are moving from demos to production systems.

stories.headline: Purdue expands AI compute with Google TPU
stories.summary: Purdue said it will be the first U.S. university to deploy Google TPU infrastructure, boosting AI compute capacity.
stories.why_it_matters: More academic access to advanced chips can speed research and training.

stories.headline: Voorhees launches AI institute with grant
stories.summary: Voorhees University said it won a U.S. Department of Labor grant to launch an Artificial Intelligence Institute.
stories.why_it_matters: New AI training centers can widen access to education and workforce prep.
